posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: Those plugins don't work because they modify the battle scene. Chrono Engine battles take place on the map scene. You could recreate the effects in the map scene but you would really have to know your way around Chrono Engine, the tool event pages, and possibly other map scene plugins. It really is not something to try to do as a beginner.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: I'll be honest with you, I can't help you much with this as I just don't use Chrono Mode or that QTE plugin. You're trying to do some way advanced things (summoning an actor instance on the map and triggering QTE sequences in the middle of an on map battle). While it is technically possible, there is not going to be any documentation for what you're trying to do and you'll largely be on your own, and it will most likely require you to edit and patch the plugins to work together.
